post.description: Renews the certificate with this id right away, without waiting for the renewal job: a self signed certificate, or a certificate signed by a certificate authority of otoroshi, is generated again with the same subject and a new validity; a let's encrypt certificate is ordered again. The certificate keeps its id.

parameters.name: certId
parameters.description: The id of the certificate to renew

200.description: The certificate renewed, with its new validity

400.description: The credentials are missing: the call carries no api key, and the route that serves the admin api refuses it before the controller runs

401.description: The credentials are wrong, or they do not give access to the admin api

403.description: The admin behind the credentials cannot write this certificate: it is not in its tenant or teams

429.description: The quotas of the credentials, or the number of calls allowed per ip address, are exceeded

500.description: The certificate could not be renewed: a certificate otoroshi did not generate (imported, without its certificate authority) cannot be, and a let's encrypt order can fail

post.summary: Remove the duplicated let's encrypt certificates
post.description: A maintenance operation for the instances that ran an older renewal of the let's encrypt certificates, which left a new active copy behind at each renewal. Among the let's encrypt certificates holding the exact same chain and key, keeps one (the plainly named one, then the smallest id) and deletes the others. With `deleteExpired=true`, also deletes the expired let's encrypt certificates whose domains are all covered by a certificate kept. Only reports what it would delete unless `dryRun=false`.

parameters.name: dryRun
parameters.description: Only reports what would be deleted, unless it is `false`

parameters.name: deleteExpired
parameters.description: Also deletes the expired let's encrypt certificates whose domains are all covered by a certificate kept

200.description: What was found, and deleted unless it is a dry run

401.description: The credentials are wrong, or they do not give access to the admin api

403.description: The admin behind the credentials is not a super admin
